strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Lozisiel pou Lavant ar Van ek Reprezantan
strings.tierB.home.description: Lozisiel pou distribiter: faktir ek resi depi portab reprezantan, stok van, koleksion larzan, rout ek vizit. Li marse san internet ek sinkronize apre.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Zere ou bann reprezantan depi premie vizit ziska dernie koleksion
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales, se enn platform cloud (lozisiel van sales ek reprezantan lavant) pou bann konpani distribision ek grosis ki ena reprezantan lor terin. Bann reprezantan fer ek imprim faktir ek resi depi zot portab, swiv stok zot van ek anrezistre zot vizit, alor ki bann manadzer trouv lavant, koleksion ek det sak kliyan an direk.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Faktir depi portab reprezantan
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Reprezantan la fer faktir la devan laport laboutik kliyan la ek imprim li lor enn imprimant termik Bluetooth avan li kit laboutik la.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Koleksion larzan ek det kliyan
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Sak peyman gagn enn resi avek nimero ki lie ar bann faktir ki li pe pey, ek det ek releve kont kliyan la met azour tousuit.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Kontrol stok van
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Sistem la swiv stok sak van prodwi par prodwi: seki finn sarze, seki finn vande, seki finn retourne ek seki reste, alor si ena enn mank, ou trouv li mem zour.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Rout ek vizit
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Sak vizit anrezistre avek lokalizasion, ler ek foto, ek manadzer la trouv rout sak reprezantan lor kart.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Li marse san internet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Bann reprezantan kontinie vande mem kan pena rezo. Dokiman res lor portab ek sinkronize otomatikman, san double, kan konneksion la retourne.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashboard web pou manadzer
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Lavant, koleksion, retour, stok ek performans sak reprezantan dan enn sel plas, avek rol ek permision pou sak itilizater.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Dir nou kouma ou vande
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Demann enn devi ouswa fix enn randevou. Nou get ou bann reprezantan, ou bann rout, ou prodwi ek seki ou bizin pou faktir.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Prepar ou konpani
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Azout prodwi, pri, kliyan ek reprezantan, ek met larzan ou pei ek pousantaz taks dan paramet.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Avoy reprezantan lor terin
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Bann reprezantan instal aplikasion la lor Android ouswa iPhone, sarz zot van ek koumans vande, imprime ek ranmas larzan.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Swiv lazourne an direk
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashboard web la montre lavant, koleksion, stok van ek vizit pandan ki bann reprezantan ankor lor sime.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales, se enn platform cloud pou zere reprezantan lavant dan bann konpani distribision ek grosis. Li kouver van sales (lavant ar van), route sales, pre-sales (pran komann avan) ek direct store delivery (DSD). Bann reprezantan fer faktir, imprime, ranmas larzan ek anrezistre vizit depi zot portab, ek bann manadzer swiv lavant, koleksion, stok van ek det kliyan depi enn dashboard web.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Wi. Aplikasion reprezantan la kontinie marse san internet: bann reprezantan fer ek imprim faktir ek resi, anrezistre vizit ek azout nouvo kliyan, ek tou sinkronize otomatikman san double kan konneksion la retourne. Ena enn sel exsepsion dan Arabi Saoudit: bann konpani ki finn aktiv lintegrasion faktir elektronik bizin enn konneksion dan moman ki zot sorti enn faktir ouswa enn retour.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales servi bann konpani distribision dan tou pei. Sak konpani met so prop larzan ek pousantaz taks dan so paramet, ek faktir, resi ek rapor servi sa bann-la. FieldSales baze Riyad, Arabi Saoudit, ek nou ed ou koumanse an ligne: randevou, WhatsApp ek siport a distans.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Eski FieldSales konekte ar sistem faktir elektronik guvernman?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Nou siport lintegrasion Faz 2 avek platform Fatoora ZATCA. Sa li pou bann konpani dan Arabi Saoudit. Dan lezot pei, Moris osi, FieldSales sorti faktir avek ou larzan ek ou pousantaz taks, ek enn konneksion ar sistem nasional faktir elektronik disponib lor demann, apre ki nou finn etidie bann exizans sa pei la ansam ar ou. Nou pa fer okenn promes ki li reponn bann regleman an deor Arabi Saoudit.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Dan ki lang aplikasion FieldSales disponib?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Lenterfas aplikasion FieldSales disponib an arab, angle, franse, tirk ek sinwa, ek zis dan sa bann lang-la. Pena lenterfas an kreol morisien, me angle ek franse ladan. Reprezantan ek manadzer kapav sanz lang lenterfas, ek faktir imprime kapav ena enn deziem lang akote lang prinsipal. Bann paz sit web dan lezot lang, kouma sa paz an kreol-la, se tradiksion pou donn linformasion lor prodwi la.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Demann enn devi, fix enn randevou ouswa avoy nou enn mesaz lor WhatsApp. Nou aprann kouma ou bann reprezantan travay, apre nou ed ou prepar prodwi, pri, kliyan ek reprezantan. Bann reprezantan instal aplikasion la lor Android ouswa iPhone, ek bann manadzer servi dashboard web la depi nenport ki navigater. Zis enn smartphone ki ou bizin kouma materyel.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Lenterfas aplikasion FieldSales disponib an arab, angle, franse, tirk ek sinwa; pena lenterfas an kreol morisien. Bann paz dan lezot lang dekrir prodwi la zis pou linformasion.
strings.tierB.category.title: Lozisiel Lavant ar Van pou Distribiter | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Lozisiel van sales ek route sales: faktir imprime depi portab reprezantan, stok van par prodwi, koleksion larzan ek vizit. Li marse san internet.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Lozisiel lavant ar van pou distribiter ek grosis
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales, se enn lozisiel lavant ar van pou bann konpani kot reprezantan vande depi enn veikil lor zot rout sak zour. Reprezantan la sarz van la, vande dan sak laboutik, imprim faktir la, ranmas larzan ek anrezistre bann retour, tou depi enn sel aplikasion lor portab. Manadzer la trouv seki finn sarze, vande, ranmase ek seki reste dan sak van.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Ki ete enn lozisiel lavant ar van?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Enn lozisiel lavant ar van, ki dimounn apel osi lozisiel cash van ouswa route sales, zere enn model lavant kot reprezantan la transport stok dan so veikil ek vande, livre, fer faktir ek ranmas larzan dan enn sel vizit. Li ranplas bann liv faktir lor papie ek bann apel telefonn lafin lazourne. Li anrezistre sak lavant, sak peyman ek sak retour kouma enn dokiman, alor ou kapav konpar stok ek kas mem zour. Pou enn manadzer, li reponn trwa kestion sak swar: ki sak reprezantan finn vande, ki sak reprezantan finn ranmase, ek ki ankor reste dan sak van?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Enn zourne lor terin
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Lazourne koumans avek enn sarzman dokimante depi depo ziska dan van. Dan sak laboutik, reprezantan la ouver fis kliyan la, azout prodwi depi lalis ouswa barcode, fer faktir la ek imprim li lor enn imprimant termik. Peyman anrezistre avek enn resi, ek sak retour anrezistre avek so rezon. Lafin lazourne, seki reste dan van desarze ar depo. Ant sa bann etap-la, manadzer la kapav swiv lavant, koleksion ek vizit sak reprezantan depi dashboard web la, san bizin telefonn personn.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Fer pou plas kot rezo feb
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Bann rout distribision pas dan sousol, zonn indistriel ek vilaz kot rezo pa bon. Aplikasion reprezantan FieldSales gard kliyan, prodwi ek pri lor portab, alor reprezantan la kapav fer ek imprim dokiman san internet. Sak dokiman ena enn kle inik (unique key), alor li monte enn sel fwa, mem si sistem la reesey plizier fwa. Bann konpani dan Arabi Saoudit ki finn aktiv lintegrasion faktir elektronik bizin konneksion dan moman ki zot sorti faktir ek retour. Pou zot osi, resi, vizit ek nouvo kliyan kontinie marse san internet.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Koleksion larzan ek responsabilite van
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Larzan lor sime bizin mem kontrol ki stok. Sak koleksion gagn enn resi avek nimero ki kapav lie ar bann faktir li pey, ek det kliyan la met azour tousuit. Stok van kalkile prodwi par prodwi: seki finn sarze mwin seki finn vande, plis retour ek bann azisteman dokimante, alor manadzer kapav konpar li ar enn kontaz fizik avan reprezantan la al lakaz. Retour kapav klase kouma normal, domaze ouswa lesanz, ek se manadzer ki deside si marsandiz retourne repas dan stok van ki kapav vande.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Pou kisannla?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales bon pou distribiter ek grosis prodwi ki vande vit (FMCG), kouma manze, bwason, prodwi netwayaz ek prodwi swin personel, ek nenport ki konpani ki so reprezantan vizit laboutik lor rout. Li siport van sales, pre-sales (komann) ek direct store delivery. Li pa enn ERP konple: li konekte ar ou sistem kontabilite ouswa ERP atraver enn API. Manadzer kontrol seki sak reprezantan gagn drwa fer, kouma donn remiz, vann anba pri lalis ouswa azout nouvo kliyan.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Ki diferans ant van sales ek pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Dan van sales, reprezantan la transport stok ek li livre, fer faktir ek ranmas larzan dan mem vizit. Dan pre-sales, reprezantan la pran enn komann ek depo la livre plitar. FieldSales siport tou le de, alor enn konpani kapav fer marse cash van lor sertin rout ek pran komann lor lezot. Dan tou le de ka, faktir, koleksion ek det kliyan dan mem sistem, ek manadzer trouv zot dan mem rapor.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Kouma pou rekonsilie enn van lafin lazourne?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales montre, pou sak prodwi dan sak van, kantite ki finn sarze, vande, retourne ek seki reste. Konpar seki reste ar enn kontaz fizik, anrezistre sak diferans kouma enn azisteman dokimante, apre desarz seki reste ar depo dan enn sel mouvman. Landime, van la koumanse avek enn balans prop ki ou konn.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Ki materyel enn reprezantan van sales bizin?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Enn smartphone, Android ouswa iPhone. Enn imprimant termik Bluetooth pa obligatwar; li permet reprezantan la donn kliyan la enn faktir ouswa enn resi imprime. FieldSales pa vann materyel ek pa egzize okenn mark imprimant. Manadzer servi dashboard web la depi nenport ki lordinater ouswa navigater lor portab.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Eski FieldSales kapav konekte ar nou sistem kontabilite?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Wi. FieldSales ofer enn API ki permet ou sistem kontabilite ouswa ERP sanz kliyan, prodwi, faktir, resi ek mouvman stok avek platform la. Ou lekip ouswa ou integrater konstrir konneksion la avek dokimantasion API la.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales par Pei: Larzan, Taks ek Faktir Elektronik
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales marse pou distribiter dan tou pei. Trouv larzan, taks ek leta faktir elektronik sak pei dan enn sel tablo.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales servi bann konpani distribision dan tou pei. Sak konpani swazir so pei, so larzan ek so pousantaz taks dan so paramet, ek faktir, resi ek rapor swiv sa. Lintegrasion ar faktir elektronik guvernman an servis dan Arabi Saoudit selman. Dan tou lezot pei, li disponib lor demann. Tablo anba la montre, pou sak pei, larzan lokal, pousantaz taks lor lavant ouswa VAT abityel, ek si enn konneksion faktir elektronik guvernman an servis ouswa disponib lor demann.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Nou siport lintegrasion Faz 2 avek platform Fatoora ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Sak konpani met larzan ek pousantaz taks dan so prop paramet. Pousantaz dan sa tablo-la zis enn gid ek zot kapav sanze; verifie regleman aktiel avek ou konseye fiskal. Enn tire (—) vedir pena okenn pousantaz zeneral pou sa pei-la.
strings.tierB.about.title: Konsernan FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales devlop lozisiel cloud pou bann konpani distribision ki ena reprezantan lor terin. Fonde an 2026 Riyad, Arabi Saoudit.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (so nom an arab: فيلد سيلز) se enn platform cloud pou bann konpani distribision ek grosis ki ena reprezantan lavant lor terin. Konpani la finn fonde an 2026 ek li baze Riyad, Arabi Saoudit. Li servi konpani dan tou pei, ek sak konpani met larzan ek pousantaz taks so pei dan so prop paramet. Nou bann kliyan, se konpani ki vande ek livre atraver reprezantan lor sime: distribiter, grosis ek fabrikan ki ena zot prop flot veikil lavant.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Nou konstrir enn sel sistem konekte pou tou travay lor terin: faktir imprime depi portab reprezantan, resi ek det kliyan, responsabilite stok van, rout ek vizit avek lokalizasion ek foto, ek enn dashboard web pou manadzer. Aplikasion reprezantan la marse lor Android ek iPhone, li kontinie marse san internet, apre li sinkronize kan konneksion retourne. Konpani kapav konekte FieldSales ar zot sistem kontabilite ouswa ERP atraver enn API, alor pa bizin tap bann done terin de fwa.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Nou dekrir prodwi la kouma li ete. Nou siport lintegrasion Faz 2 avek platform Fatoora ZATCA. Lintegrasion avek sistem guvernman dan lezot pei disponib lor demann. Lenterfas aplikasion la disponib an arab, angle, franse, tirk ek sinwa; pena lenterfas an kreol morisien. Pou koz ar nou, demann enn devi, fix enn randevou ouswa avoy nou enn mesaz lor WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Kontakt FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Koz ar lekip FieldSales: demann enn devi, fix enn randevou ouswa koz ar nou lor WhatsApp lor lozisiel field sales ek lavant ar van.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Dir nou kouma ou bann reprezantan vande zordi ek ki ou anvi sanze. Demann enn devi, fix enn randevou ouswa avoy nou enn mesaz lor WhatsApp, ek enn manm nou lekip pou reponn ou. Pou siport, bann kliyan ki deza avek nou kapav servi mem kanal. Li ede si ou mansionn ou pei, kantite reprezantan, ek si zot vande ar van, pran komann ouswa fer tou le de.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Fix enn randevou an ligne avek nou lekip. Nou pou montre ou enn zourne reprezantan dan aplikasion la ek dashboard manadzer la, avek legzanp ki pre ar ou prodwi ek ou rout, ek reponn ou kestion lor kouma pou met li an plas.
